routing.criterion: Routing category accuracy (Nova Lite, eval split)
routing.n: n=300 eval-split ids (full reused file; no new Bedrock calls)
routing.notes: Known conflict: 95% is unreachable on this data (Gate 2 bake-off best 82.0%; keep-initial baseline 84.7%). Reported, not redefined.

routing_regression.notes: Proposed replacement gate (orchestrator); the 95% row above stays reported.

injection.criterion: Injection sent to a human (model flag or guard), safety SAMPLE
injection.n: SAMPLE n=60 injection + n=20 benign, seed 20261108
injection.notes: Measured on the existing run (not tuned). 10 of 60 injection tickets are auto-routed by Nova-only routing: accepted Gate 3 exception (AUTO_SEND=false, kill switch, human approves every draft). Builder B's promptfoo red team is the fuller injection test.

p1.criterion: Priority P1 count (model) on routing eval
p1.notes: P1 recall is weak (0 of 2 vs SLA-breach labels, 2 of 10 vs proxy): Gate 3 exception (i).

dedupe_meridian.criterion: Dedupe: Meridian incident opens at the 5th similar ticket (PN-101239)
dedupe_meridian.value: first flagged PN-101239 (rank 5); 26/30 in one incident

dedupe_false_incidents.criterion: Dedupe: false incidents on ordinary routing tickets

dedupe_resubmits.criterion: Dedupe: resubmits linked to the correct parent
dedupe_resubmits.value: 25/26 correct, 1 wrong parent, 0 pulled into an incident
dedupe_resubmits.notes: False links on routing tickets: 27/625 (mostly identical template twins). Not a blind test (grid extended after eval was seen).

langfuse_export_masking.criterion: Langfuse mask_otel_spans: no raw PII on the SDK export path (no server)
langfuse_export_masking.notes: In-memory exporter after the hook. Whether the hook runs before a custom span_exporter is SDK behaviour; the server test below is the real proof.

langfuse_masking.criterion: Langfuse stored trace contains no raw PII (LangGraph callback + mask_otel_spans), real server v4.79.0
langfuse_masking.n: n=1 PII-bearing LangGraph trace, 5 canaries (IBAN, Emirates ID, PAN, email, phone)
langfuse_masking.notes: Read back through the Langfuse public observations API (v2) after ingestion; scanned with the canaries and Presidio/regex scanner.

pii.criterion: PII leaks in drafts, outbox, approvals, audit, answer_cache, checkpoints, Valkey
pii.n: n=60 harvested tickets + 1 live tool ticket; 43 raw PII values checked as canaries; 11067 text fragments across 16 stores (2 Valkey strings)
pii.notes: Scanner = Presidio + regex/legacy layers, NER off for names. Raw scanner hits lying entirely inside a UUID (LangGraph checkpoint ids) are counted apart, not as leaks: 86 such hits {'db.checkpoints:AADHAAR': 58, 'db.checkpoints:PHONE': 4, 'db.checkpoint_blobs:AADHAAR': 10, 'db.checkpoint_blobs:PHONE': 2, 'db.checkpoint_writes:AADHAAR': 10, 'db.checkpoint_writes:PHONE': 2}; they are digit runs inside UUIDs / long hex ids read as Aadhaar/phone numbers (verified by shape, no values printed).

cost.criterion: Cost per draft (classifier + agent + guard, Bedrock list prices)
cost.notes: Total 433341 input / 22061 output tokens. Agent-only share recomputed from tokens x price: mean USD 0.00145.

latency.criterion: Latency p50/p95 per lane (full graph run)
latency.value: overall p50 11.9s, p95 40.2s; with a draft p95 43.2s
latency.notes: Per lane: auto_answer: p50 16.1s / p95 21.3s (n=3); block: p50 8.3s / p95 8.3s (n=1); draft_for_agent: p50 11.9s / p95 18.7s (n=25); human_review: p50 15.9s / p95 54.0s (n=26); route_queue: p50 11.9s / p95 20.3s (n=5). Includes Nova throttling waits (10 RPM quota) and the Qwen3-235B agent loop. Known conflict, not redefined.

stale_chunks.criterion: Stale chunks retrieved (effective date vs ticket received date)
stale_chunks.value: 0 stale of 295 retrieved chunks (60 statutory rule chunks)
stale_chunks.n: n=60 tickets, all sets in the harvest
stale_chunks.notes: A chunk is stale when effective_to < received date or effective_from > received date.

rule_retrieved.criterion: Decisive statutory rule is among the top-5 retrieved chunks
rule_retrieved.notes: Misses are retrieval-recall gaps (e.g. PF rule not retrieved for some PF tickets), not stale chunks: PN-100501:R-IN-PF-2026-08, PN-100634:R-IN-PF-2026-08, PN-100794:R-IN-PF-2026-08, PN-100836:R-IN-PF-2026-08, PN-101414:R-IN-PF-2026-08, PN-100003:R-IN-PF-2026-08
